observations: Lower left wing has a visibly gray pitched roof with repeated narrow parallel ribs/seams.
A small right shoulder/eave roof strip on the church assembly also appears ribbed.
The tall central front gable and vegetation occlude much of the main sanctuary roof; a ground photo does not establish its full rear/upper surface finish.
Broad metal-like ribbed appearance is qualitatively plausible; exact seam construction, coating, pitch, height, panel length and material alloy cannot be measured from this photograph.

material_boundaries.main_sanctuary_shell: Application across the modeled main SanctuaryCandidateV3 roof subset is an estimated visual continuity extension, not an observed whole-roof reconstruction.
material_boundaries.adjacent_wings: Do not extend automatically to other wing/campus/legacy roofs. Visible lower wing evidence does not establish that every shell face is the same roof system.
material_boundaries.belfry_and_spire: Exclude cap, louver enclosure and spire from this proposal; their finish/geometry has separate evidence and limits.
material_boundaries.walls: Preserve existing wall material, st mapping, normals, positions, topology and transforms.
material_boundaries.roof_orientation: Rib direction should follow each sloping plane toward ridge/eave, with seams consistent at joins. Avoid a fixed world direction that creates horizontal contour stripes across the pitch.
material_boundaries.roof_geometry: Keep source roof envelope unchanged; normal-only relief must not be described as measured standing-seam geometry or silhouette detail.

proposed_parameters.measurement_status: All are author-chosen visual estimates, not dimensions inferred from the photograph.
proposed_parameters.color_roughness: Gray/metal-like impression supported qualitatively; precise albedo/roughness/metalness remains estimated under uncontrolled sunlight.
proposed_parameters.dedicated_uv: Roof-only roof_st primvar and binding can separate appearance from wall UVs; implementation and actual render still require review.

next_gates: Independent roof-subset/material/UV containment and unchanged geometry/wall audit after proposal generation.
Actual same-camera render inspect for seam direction, repeat scale, ridge/eave joins, excessive bump, moire and bright/dark bands.
Compare neutral baseline; normal-only effect should remain restrained at conference viewing resolution.
Any adoption requires separate canonical source and additive preservation checks; this source review authorizes no active-layer change.
